name: The Ritz Carlton, Pentagon City
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel in Arlington, Virginia (official name The Ritz-Carlton, Pentagon City), two Metro stops from downtown Washington, DC
best_for: Travelers who want a Metro-connected base for visiting Washington, DC
Guests who want Club Lounge access with views of the Pentagon and the monuments

facts.text: The hotel is at 1250 South Hayes Street, Arlington, Virginia.
The hotel is two Metro stops from downtown Washington, DC.
The hotel is steps from Fashion Centre at Pentagon City and Pentagon Row.
Santé is the hotel's Mediterranean-inspired restaurant on the lobby level, with seasonal ingredients and handcrafted cocktails.
Guest room beds have Egyptian cotton linens.
Bathrooms have Italian marble and rainfall showerheads.
Monument View Rooms and Suites are offered, as are Premier Rooms on higher floors.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has views of Arlington and Washington, D.C., a living and dining area, a bedroom and Club Lounge access.
The third-floor Fitness Center has a Peloton bike, steam room and sauna.
The Club Lounge offers five complimentary food and beverage presentations each day.

highlights.text: The Club Lounge is on the 18th floor, with views of the Pentagon and Washington, DC's monuments.
The Club Lounge has an Enomatic wine system with a selection of rare wines chosen by a sommelier.
Each evening, Virginia apples hand-dipped in a seasonal flavor are presented in the Lobby.
Afternoon Tea includes a Teddy Bear Tea for children, with hot chocolate and a teddy bear to take home.
The hotel offers the Ritz Kids program for children.

considerations.text: Club Lounge access requires a Club Level booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite status does not include it.
The hotel has no airport shuttle to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may lack resort-style tranquility.
